Coverage_Description: Single-premium USD investment-linked life plan with lifelong cover; policy account value follows selected investment options; death benefit is 105% of policy account value
pricing: Minimum single premium US$15,000; maximum allowed single premium is subject to underwriting requirements.
customer requirement: Submit application form with required premium; approval is subject to Prudential's internal underwriting guidelines
price structure: One-off lump-sum premium in USD; no extra premium accepted after policy issuance
additional informations: Investment bonus from policy year 6 onward when average monthly policy account value is at least US$15,000 and policy is in force; 21-day cooling-off period
